title: Suspicious Rundll32 Execution From Temp
id: f5a333d7-0c6c-45e2-a573-650845b897b9
description: Detects suspicious rundll32 executions from temporary directories, which is a common technique used by malicious tools like Cobalt Strike
status: experimental
date: 2026/04/09
modified: 2026/04/09
author: SOC Automation
references:
    - Internal Rule
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1218/011/
    - https://www.fireeye.com/services/freeware/flawer.html
logic:
    selection:
        img:
            - '*.exe'
        cmd:
            - 'rundll32.exe'
        arg:
            - '*\Temp\*'
            - '*\AppData\Local\Temp\*'
            - '*\TMP\*'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Unusual legitimate software
level: high
